CFML Language Reference: Functions

BitSHLN

Shifts a 32-bit integer count bits to the left. Zeros come in from the right and bits shifted past bit 31 are lost.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

BitSHLN(number, count)

Parameters

number
A 32-bit integer.
count
Number of positions to shift, 0 to 31.

Returns

A signed 32-bit integer.

Usage

Shifting left by n multiplies by 2^n as long as nothing falls off the top. Shifting a 1 into bit 31 gives a negative number (-2147483648), because the result is signed.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>number</TH><TH>count</TH><TH>BitSHLN(number, count)</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="args" LIST="1:0,1:4,3:8,255:8,1:31">
<CFSET n = ListFirst(args, ":")><CFSET c = ListLast(args, ":")>
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#n#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#c#</TD>
<TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#BitSHLN(n, c)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
